counts.version: K6 v2 (graded with the 11 Nov grader) PROPOSED
counts.pad_rule: v5: footprint + 1.5 m street side / ends, + 0.4 m rear (front rows); 1.5 m all round otherwise

buildings seated.rule: every building must be seated as drawn

refusals by kind.rule: first failed test per refused building

pad-pad clash.rule: two pads at different levels may not share a grid point (all buildings, order-free)
pad-pad clash.result: 0 pairs of pad groups, 0 shared points

pad-street / ramp / lane clash.rule: no pad point may sit on a street, lane, path or square point at another level (all buildings, order-free)

street-street clash.rule: grid points two streets both claim at different levels; the earlier street keeps its level there, so the later one gets a step. A few at a junction where a ramp meets a level street are normal; dozens mean two streets run over each other at different levels (report)

square.rule: one level; every point within 4.0 m of natural ground; no street point at another level; 31 deg bank to everything else
square.result: level 1.50 m, cut/fill max 2.00 m, 0 points meet streets at another level ; ok

pad cut / fill (true grid).rule: every pad point within 4.0 m of the natural ground; aim for 2.5 m (all buildings as drawn)
pad cut / fill (true grid).result: median 2.85 m, max 3.98 m, 52 over 2.5 m, 0 over 4.0 m

ground solvable.rule: 31 deg cones between all fixed points must meet (seated set)

door threshold vs ground 1 m out.rule: pad (= floor = threshold) within 5 cm of the graded surface 1 m out of the door (seated)

door threshold vs street surface.rule: pad within 5 cm of its street's level at the door's station, for doors within 12 m of the centre line (seated)
door threshold vs street surface.result: 77 checked, 0 fail ; 0 doors more than 12 m from their street (listed in result.json)

wall below ground.rule: highest ground 0.25 m outside the walls minus the floor <= 0.3 m (seated)

overlaps.rule: no two footprint boxes overlap (whole layout as drawn)

in a street ribbon (own street).rule: footprint >= half-width + 0.2 m from its own street's centre line (whole layout)

corner clearance (other streets).rule: footprint >= half-width + 1.0 m from every other street's centre line (whole layout)

back-to-back gap (31 deg bank).rule: pads at different levels need at least |dz| / 0.6 m between their grid points (first failure per building)

banks facing streets.rule: a graded bank over 1.5 m seen from a main street or lane edge, before any building (seated set; report)

straight runs.rule: no main street or lane straight for more than 80 m (within 1.0 m of its chord)
straight runs.result: longest main street or lane: R2 62.6 m; roads and paths (report): R3 39.3 m, R4 35.3 m

street grades.rule: main streets under 5 % (8 % average, 12 % on a short drop), lanes under 19 %, paths are stairs (report)

model / twin share (drawn).rule: any one model <= 15 %, any one twin group (colour variants of one house) <= 12 %
model / twin share (drawn).result: largest model ND03 9 = 11.4 %, largest twin group ND03 9 = 11.4 %

model / twin share (seated).rule: any one model <= 15 %, any one twin group (colour variants of one house) <= 12 % (the check is on the town as drawn; the seated share is a report)
model / twin share (seated).result: largest model ND03 9 = 11.4 %, largest twin group ND03 9 = 11.4 %

comp seat and height.rule: whole comps with a footprint, if given
comp seat and height.result: none given with a footprint (roles only)
